# ⏱️ Benchmark Record

## Objective
Operation measured and rationale.

## Environment
Hardware, OS, Python and package versions.

## Code and workload
Commit, function, input dimensions, sample count and generator.

## Procedure
Warm-up, repetitions, timing method and UI isolation.

## Results
Actual measurements and summary statistics. Never invent results.

## Interpretation and reproduction
What results do/do not prove, plus exact command.
